review.scope: 3 tasks x 1 seed x 3 checkpoints, same prompt/seed/LoRA strength 0.75; qualitative comparison to canonical N00 and baseline
review.selection_reason_ja: 400版より800版で前髪・顔立ちと体格、立位の傾向が教材に近づいた。800版と1200版の3課題の差は小さく、1200版を優先する明確な改善を確認できなかったため、初回候補には800版を採用。全般的な最適値を証明した選定ではない。
observations: Baseline has different bangs, windblown/wavy hair, sharper stylized shading and body proportions. All trained candidates move toward the provided character examples.
Green sports jacket and red blouse are retained in all three checkpoints; the original blue cardigan is not forced onto these two clothing tests.
Default cardigan tends to close over the torso; necklace decoration differs. Clothing microdetails are not faithfully fixed.
Profile retains a more painterly/shiny red garment and stronger shading than the original reference.
800 and 1200 step versions are visually similar in this small screen. Selection is provisional until the second-seed/pose/expression matrix.
review.next: 6-task, 2-seed baseline vs selected comparison; no new training before reporting v1

prototype_limitations: skirt length and color can drift
